runs.scope: Four reused development regions, unchanged r44 control runs only. Separate from the 51-evaluation P8d candidate budget; no search, coefficients, objective, selection, independent pool or adoption changes.
runs.interpretation: Signed contributions to the current discrete concentration-transport equation. Convergence import and storm exchange are parameterized. This is neither causal counterfactual attribution nor proof of a globally conserved water or energy budget. Monsoon drying is a subset of column drying and must not be counted twice.
